purpose: DESCRIPTIVE robustness of the live noise-band setting on the tuning years only; nothing here selects a parameter.

window.note: first 31 sessions skipped so every lookback (max 30) is warm in every column

book: 50% SPY + 50% QQQ per symbol, 1 bp per side; metric = annualised Sharpe of daily returns

max_cell_in_grid.note: reported only to judge spike vs plateau; NOT adopted

runtime.note: SPY time includes numba JIT compile of the vectorbt kernels (~6 s, once per process). engine = intraday.noise_breakout in a Python loop (no band / VWAP switch, so extrapolated from the 30 lookback x check configs it can run)
